title: Partial Amendments to Accounting Standard for Retirement Benefits
summary: Partial Amendments to Accounting Standard for Retirement Benefits is part of the Japan GAAP framework.
description: This standard is part of the Japan GAAP framework issued by the Accounting Standards Board of Japan (ASBJ). It provides guidance on partial amendments to accounting standard for retirement benefits.

bannerNotice.title: Abolished Standard
bannerNotice.body: This standard has been abolished and is no longer in effect.
